blocks.text:
Upon arrival in Rio de Janeiro, transfer to your hotel. Rio is green hills, blue sky, beautiful bays, islands and marvellous beaches: Brazil’s second-largest city after São Paulo and certainly one of the most beautiful in the world.

The most popular beaches, Copacabana, Ipanema and Leblon, are famous for their black-and-white mosaic promenades, where people play football and volleyball on the golden sand from early morning until late at night. For those who enjoy an active holiday, Rio offers almost any sport, from golf, tennis and surfing to diving and hang-gliding; beach cafés serve refreshing coconut water and freshly squeezed juices, and local musicians often play on the beach.

blocks.text: Rio de Janeiro and Sugar Loaf

provenance.wordAbsenceReason: The Word combines days 2–4 in one heading; this is the separate RU day-two title.

blocks.text: Day 2 · After breakfast, an excursion to Sugar Loaf. The first stop is Urca Hill, with its wide viewing area and bar; from Sugar Loaf, enjoy a beautiful view of Rio, Copacabana Beach, the bay, the surrounding mountains and islands, the Rio–Niterói Bridge, Guanabara Bay and the statue of Christ on Corcovado. Then drive to the old centre of Rio to admire its churches, monasteries, cathedral, the Uruguaiana and Carioca streets and its colonial-style buildings.
